parameters.name: maxDiffByte
parameters.description:
The maximum size of the diff to return, in bytes.

> The maximum value for this parameter is 24 MB (25,165,824 bytes).

parameters.name: maxDiffFile
parameters.description:
The maximum number of files to return.

> The maximum value for this parameter is 5,000.

parameters.name: mergeBase
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the merge base for the comparison.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL of the Alibaba Cloud DevOps console, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}`.
